lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. No decision is needed from Brandon now.

The eleventh publish is live since 23:22 UTC (4:22 PM MT). It is the build of commit d68e5dca: round one of the iteration and the mend that lets summer be made again at low and medium quality. It does not hold round two yet. Before it went out, measured here: the whole test run ended with exit 0, 1035 passed and 9 skipped; the page's 40 first pictures agree with the page's framing; a second build without the sounds gave the same 17 files as the security reviewers read. The fourteenth security reviewer found nothing that blocks and gave no warning (stated). After the upload four files read back equal to my folder's, and a request without a sign in is refused with 401 on three paths. Visibility: Organization.

Round two has landed on main at 23:23 UTC (4:23 PM MT) as commit 48a2e3b7. Chain 39 measured its eleven parts together on a helper and every floor I set held; winter did not move. Stated by the helper, chain 38's value in brackets: sharpness against the approved picture at rest for spring 0.9247 (0.9022), summer 0.8981 (0.8624), fall 0.858 (0.8587); cover at the swap for the four shakes 0.9694, 0.889, 0.9559, 0.9596 (0.9694, 0.889, 0.956, 0.9599); the miniature seen again after the landing 0.9932, 1, 0.9899, 0.9998 (0.9932, 1, 0.9882, 0.9996); at most 1,774,148 of 1,800,000 triangles; the whole test run 1049 passed and 8 skipped. Falls, each inside its floor: the base's part of spring's number 0.934 to 0.925, of fall's 0.859 to 0.858, the cover of shake 3 by 0.0001 and of shake 4 by 0.0003. Measured here: the six stills that moved have the hashes the helper named, the engine hash is the same on my merged tree, and the sound mix's 46 tests pass.

Where the three seasons stand by my eye, each new still beside its approved picture: all three are nearer and all three are below the bar. Summer's base is now carved sand with shells and sea glass and its lawn is green; its storm at the landing hides the whole miniature where the approved lets the cottage and the tree show through, its seeds at rest are large stars where the approved has fine sparks, and the base reads browner than the approved's pale cream. Fall's tree has few bare boughs as the approved has and the base's wall is near black with thin wax; the air inside is greener and flatter than the approved's, and from the close camera the near fence reads as combs of streaks. Spring is the nearest; its base stands taller and darker and its petals in the air are larger. Three fresh critics of other model families than round two's are judging summer, fall and spring on these stills now. Their scores are for the question to Brandon, not for a new round.

Fall's air is accepted by decision 235. Its builder split the rise that held it: of 0.201 more things living for one frame, 0.089 came with main's own merges before any line of round two, 0.075 with the darker air and 0.037 with the glow (stated). I looked at its frames at full size with their difference: each point's two places stand side by side, nothing is torn, and the ember that sat on the chimney's corner is gone. It goes into the next measuring run with the other late pieces: the mend of the petals' rib (report due about 23:30 UTC, 4:30 PM MT), summer's see through swirl (about 00:05 UTC, 5:05 PM MT) and the patch for the stall at low quality (by 00:15 UTC, 5:15 PM MT).

Next, in this order. The twelfth publish puts round two on the live page: a helper draws the page's first pictures on the new main now, then the tests here, a fresh security reviewer and the publish. Then the next measuring run with the late pieces, a publish of it, and Preview 07, a draft of the whole film with sound. With the twelfth publish live comes the status that gives the address with stills, says where each season stands and asks whether to move on to the film. No round three without his word.
The final render on his own computer: the builder of the one file is at work since 23:06 UTC (4:06 PM MT); no message from it yet. No final render is started in the cloud.

Open: summer's see through at the landing (being built), the petals' rib (mend drawn, not merged), the stall at low quality (patch ordered), winter's four items (no builder in round two), a faint saw tooth in the grass left of summer's pond (item 270), the petals' fringe at film frame 680 (not begun), a nudge at film frames 2113 to 2117, fall's near fence and the pumpkin's stepped face from the close camera (new, seen by me in chain 39's stills). The change of season's white mound at film frames 670 and 671 is gone at 4K on its builder's head (looked at by me); the merged tree's frames 668 to 671 are being drawn.
Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger at 23:27 UTC, 52 calls), no call since 05:47 UTC on Thursday (10:47 PM MT Wednesday). No film render and no new preview since Preview 06.
